COMPONENTS: A deck of 36 cards, 4 colours (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow) x values 1-9, each card written like 'R7'. There are 5 Stones numbered 1-5. Each Stone has a side for Player A and a side for Player B, and each side holds at most 3 cards.

SETUP: The deck is shuffled. Each player is dealt 6 cards face down. Each hand is private: only its owner sees it. The remaining 24 cards form a face-down draw pile. Seat 1 is Player A and seat 2 is Player B; A takes the first turn.

ROUNDS: The game has at most 30 rounds. In odd rounds Player A is active; in even rounds Player B is active. Each round: (1) Both players are told the cards on every side of every Stone, which Stones are claimed and by whom, each player's number of claimed Stones, and how many cards remain in the draw pile. (2) The active player chooses one card from their hand. (3) The active player chooses one Stone that is unclaimed and whose side for that player holds fewer than 3 cards; only such Stones are offered. A player always has such a Stone and a card to play, and must play. (4) The card moves from the hand to that player's side of the chosen Stone, face up. Cards never move again. (5) If this card was the third card on that side and the other side has fewer than 3 cards, this player is recorded as that Stone's 'first finisher'; otherwise nothing is recorded. (6) If the draw pile is not empty, the active player draws its top card into their hand; if it is empty, no card is drawn. (7) Every unclaimed Stone where both sides now hold 3 cards is resolved. (8) If either player has claimed 3 Stones, the game ends immediately and that player wins; otherwise play continues.

STRENGTH OF A SIDE: Let the three values sum to S. The side has one formation: Straight Flush (all three cards share a colour, the values are all different, and highest minus lowest equals 2): bonus 120. Three of a Kind (all three values equal): bonus 90. Flush (all three cards share a colour, not a Straight Flush): bonus 60. Straight (values all different, highest minus lowest equals 2, not a Straight Flush): bonus 30. Otherwise: bonus 0. Strength = S + bonus. END: The first player to claim 3 of the 5 Stones wins immediately. If the game reaches the end of round 30 without this, the player with more claimed Stones wins; equal counts are a draw (a shared win).

(3) The active player chooses one Stone that is unclaimed and whose side for that player holds fewer than 3 cards; only such Stones are offered. ROUNDS: The game has at most 30 rounds. In odd rounds Player A is active; in even rounds Player B is active. Each round: (1) Both players are told the cards on every side of every Stone, which Stones are claimed and by whom, each player's number of claimed Stones, and how many cards remain in the draw pile. (2) The active player chooses one card from their hand. (3) The active player chooses one Stone that is unclaimed and whose side for that player holds fewer than 3 cards; only such Stones are offered. A player always has such a Stone and a card to play, and must play. (4) The card moves from the hand to that player's side of the chosen Stone, face up. Cards never move again. (5) If this card was the third card on that side and the other side has fewer than 3 cards, this player is recorded as that Stone's 'first finisher'; otherwise nothing is recorded. (6) If the draw pile is not empty, the active player draws its top card into their hand; if it is empty, no card is drawn. (7) Every unclaimed Stone where both sides now hold 3 cards is resolved. (8) If either player has claimed 3 Stones, the game ends immediately and that player wins; otherwise play continues.

The side has one formation: Straight Flush (all three cards share a colour, the values are all different, and highest minus lowest equals 2): bonus 120. records.prompt:
[user]
=== Schotten Totten: Five Stones ===

COMPONENTS: A deck of 36 cards, 4 colours (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow) x values 1-9, each card written like 'R7'. There are 5 Stones numbered 1-5. Each Stone has a side for Player A and a side for Player B, and each side holds at most 3 cards.

SETUP: The deck is shuffled. Each player is dealt 6 cards face down. Each hand is private: only its owner sees it. The remaining 24 cards form a face-down draw pile. Seat 1 is Player A and seat 2 is Player B; A takes the first turn.

ROUNDS: The game has at most 30 rounds. In odd rounds Player A is active; in even rounds Player B is active. Each round: (1) Both players are told the cards on every side of every Stone, which Stones are claimed and by whom, each player's number of claimed Stones, and how many cards remain in the draw pile. (2) The active player chooses one card from their hand. (3) The active player chooses one Stone that is unclaimed and whose side for that player holds fewer than 3 cards; only such Stones are offered. A player always has such a Stone and a card to play, and must play. (4) The card moves from the hand to that player's side of the chosen Stone, face up. Cards never move again. (5) If this card was the third card on that side and the other side has fewer than 3 cards, this player is recorded as that Stone's 'first finisher'; otherwise nothing is recorded. (6) If the draw pile is not empty, the active player draws its top card into their hand; if it is empty, no card is drawn. (7) Every unclaimed Stone where both sides now hold 3 cards is resolved. (3) The active player chooses one Stone that is unclaimed and whose side for that player holds fewer than 3 cards; only such Stones are offered. A player always has such a Stone and a card to play, and must play. (4) The card moves from the hand to that player's side of the chosen Stone, face up. Cards never move again. === Schotten Totten: Five Stones ===

COMPONENTS: A deck of 36 cards, 4 colours (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow) x values 1-9, each card written like 'R7'. There are 5 Stones numbered 1-5. Each Stone has a side for Player A and a side for Player B, and each side holds at most 3 cards.

SETUP: The deck is shuffled. Each player is dealt 6 cards face down. Each hand is private: only its owner sees it. The remaining 24 cards form a face-down draw pile. Seat 1 is Player A and seat 2 is Player B; A takes the first turn.

ROUNDS: The game has at most 30 rounds. In odd rounds Player A is active; in even rounds Player B is active. Each round: (1) Both players are told the cards on every side of every Stone, which Stones are claimed and by whom, each player's number of claimed Stones, and how many cards remain in the draw pile. (2) The active player chooses one card from their hand. (3) The active player chooses one Stone that is unclaimed and whose side for that player holds fewer than 3 cards; only such Stones are offered. A player always has such a Stone and a card to play, and must play. (4) The card moves from the hand to that player's side of the chosen Stone, face up. Cards never move again. (5) If this card was the third card on that side and the other side has fewer than 3 cards, this player is recorded as that Stone's 'first finisher'; otherwise nothing is recorded. (6) If the draw pile is not empty, the active player draws its top card into their hand; if it is empty, no card is drawn. (7) Every unclaimed Stone where both sides now hold 3 cards is resolved. (8) If either player has claimed 3 Stones, the game ends immediately and that player wins; otherwise play continues.

Each round: (1) Both players are told the cards on every side of every Stone, which Stones are claimed and by whom, each player's number of claimed Stones, and how many cards remain in the draw pile. (3) The active player chooses one Stone that is unclaimed and whose side for that player holds fewer than 3 cards; only such Stones are offered. Straight (values all different, highest minus lowest equals 2, not a Straight Flush): bonus 30. Otherwise: bonus 0. Strength = S + bonus. (3) The active player chooses one Stone that is unclaimed and whose side for that player holds fewer than 3 cards; only such Stones are offered. A player always has such a Stone and a card to play, and must play. (4) The card moves from the hand to that player's side of the chosen Stone, face up. Cards never move again. (2) The active player chooses one card from their hand. (3) The active player chooses one Stone that is unclaimed and whose side for that player holds fewer than 3 cards; only such Stones are offered. (5) If this card was the third card on that side and the other side has fewer than 3 cards, this player is recorded as that Stone's 'first finisher'; otherwise nothing is recorded. (2) The active player chooses one card from their hand. (3) The active player chooses one Stone that is unclaimed and whose side for that player holds fewer than 3 cards; only such Stones are offered. A player always has such a Stone and a card to play, and must play. (4) The card moves from the hand to that player's side of the chosen Stone, face up. Cards never move again.
